item.description:
3 levels transparent water purifier | Zero wastewater and no electricity model (desktop/wall mounted dual-use)
💧  Multiple filtration to retain minerals | Visual water purification, creating a worry free and healthy drinking water solution!

No need for power supply, zero wastewater discharge, perfect for various scenarios such as renting and self occupied housing. The countertop placement saves space and the wall mounted installation is cleaner, flexibly meeting different kitchen layout needs. The transparent shell design allows you to witness the entire purification process of tap water from turbidity to clarity in real time, with visible purification effects and reassuring drinking experience.

##Core advantages
✅  Three level deep purification system: PP melt blown pre filter layer accurately intercepts large particle impurities such as sediment and rust, protecting subsequent filter elements; The five in one mineral filter layer filters out small impurities and colloids, while firmly retaining beneficial minerals such as calcium and magnesium, avoiding "excessive purification" and making the water sweet and delicious; The CTO compressed activated carbon layer deeply adsorbs residual chlorine, odors, and small organic matter, further enhancing the taste of drinking water.
✅  No electricity and zero wastewater design: No wiring or finding sockets required, can be installed anywhere in the kitchen, portable for moving and not idle; 100% water resource utilization rate, no waste, long-term use saves water costs, is environmentally friendly and economical.
✅  Universal compatibility+easy installation: equipped with a universal interface, compatible with most spiral and snap on faucets on the market, without the need to purchase additional adapters; 3-second quick installation does not require professional tools and can be independently operated by girls.

##Warm reminder
To ensure optimal filtration efficiency, it is recommended to regularly replace the filter element based on daily water usage and local water quality (specific replacement intervals can be consulted with customer service); Please tighten the hose interface during installation to avoid water leakage.

Get this convenient and practical water purifier now, bid farewell to complex water purification equipment and waste of wastewater, and let the whole family drink clean and healthy drinking water anytime, worry free and at ease！
